title: Fix Nx Configs After Folder Restructure
description: The folder layout has massively changed and was structured. Make sure all configs and imports are updated so everything runs with Nx. Initial failures observed from `bunx nx run-many -t build --all --nxBail`: `@semio/rs:build-wasm` fails on Windows with `spawn C:\WINDOWS\system32\cmd.exe ENOENT` from `bun scripts/build-wasm.mjs`, and `@elements/ui:build` Storybook fails to resolve `@coda/desktop/renderer` from `elements/ui/.storybook/stories/OntologyTree.stories.tsx`. Work end-to-end until Nx is green or remaining blockers are validated and isolated.
